title: Ellis B Possible NDE 163
content: I was sitting on my couch and my breathing was cut off. I was staring at my hand, and I saw myself draw away from my body. Then, something or someone 'pushed' me back into the world. I stood up quickly because the whole thing startled me.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No I was sitting on my couch and my breathing was cut off. I was staring at my hand, and I saw myself draw away from my body. Then, something or someone 'pushed' me back into the world. I stood up quickly because I was startled by the whole thing. Life threatening event, but not clinical death You could consider it either one of these - I was entirely conscious through the whole thing. Well, not really. I did stop breathing; at least, I'm fairly sure I did.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Special Knowledge | Life review | Vision of the future | Boundary | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I'm not sure what you mean by this. Did I feel a separation of mind and body? Yes.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was fully aware of everything, but the event caught me off guard, and, with time, my recollection is somewhat diminished.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I'm not sure on this -- if you asked me how long the event took, I would not be able to tell you -- it seemed to happen very fast.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Uncertain I didn't see or meet anyone or anything, but there was definitely someone else 'there'.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I was startled more than anything.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe This is difficult to explain. It made me see the world a bit differently. We are all people, but we are not really all the same. It gave me somewhat of a sense of clarity about my destiny, and the change, but myself was really not very dramatic. It didn't really tell me anything I didn't already know. It may have clarified it.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I'm not really sure of this. I didn't learn anything new.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Definitely. This was probably the most profound thing that happened. I have become extremely psychic, which I don't think I had before. I get thoughts or predictions about things and people. Sometimes I'm right and sometimes I'm not. It's about 50-50.
elements.Did you reach a boundary or limiting phy: Uncertain As I stated, I felt something or someone push me back. If this is what you mean by a boundary, then yes I did encounter one. I believe that once you cross this boundary, you cannot come back.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No Not at all. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes It's hard to describe because I had never experienced anything like it.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: It was somewhat frightening. The best part is that I am absolutely one hundred percent sure, that there is an afterlife of some kind.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: No I haven't. I find it somewhat embarrassing. They are aware, however, that something happened to me.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: The only thing I can think of and I want to share with you is that when I stated that someone pushed me back, I can tell you that I think I know who this person is. It is a deceased relative whom I never met. I can't verify this of course, but I have really strong feelings about this -- I'm virtually positive that I know who it is.
